objective_contribution: Test whether a single receipt-bound handoff at each recycle boundary improves GLM-5.3-flash useful continuity at 8K while eliminating repeated within-generation state tokens and recycle amplification.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does presenting receipt-bound state once on the first dispatched request of each recycled generation retain useful continuity while removing repeated state input and recycle amplification?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: R10-D matched matrix, R10-P initial-envelope preflight, R10-F D03/D07/D08 binding and exact freeze closure remain.

measurement_mapping.native: Paired native ContextBench span and file metrics measure evidence-selection usefulness; they do not establish patch correctness.
measurement_mapping.retention: A receipt-bound first request in every recycled generation establishes exposure; improved native outcome is required for useful-retention support.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Every state fact, presentation generation, dispatched request, final source credit, correction, and terminal effect is independently checked.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input and output tokens for all successful, failed, corrective, recovery, state, and terminal requests. Tokenizer-only calls remain outside the selected cost.
measurement_mapping.transfer: One exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K development round cannot establish larger windows, other models, other domains, semantic retention, repair correctness, confirmation, or clearance.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter first; finish 8K development before 10K/12K or other models.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Rounds one through nine and the eight development identities are exposed; reserved confirmation stays untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, task replacement, source refresh, prompt/cap/threshold change, or lucky rerun. Retain all outcomes and stop on shared failure.

retained_counterevidence: Round four handle-only recovery had negligible native gain, file regression, and 77,656 extra model tokens.
Round five terminal validity improved envelopes but did not establish useful state or correctness.
Rounds six through eight exposed provider, speculative-measurement, token-fit, and output-cap boundaries before a complete state comparison.
Round nine completed all cells but complete-pair state span F1 was 0.0655 lower, state used 86,838 more model tokens, and state caused twelve more recycles.
Round nine repeated state 52 times within already resumed generations, directly occupying 42,681 model-input tokens.
The output-cap correction remains live-unexposed, and semantic reasoning may remain the limiting factor.
successor_rule: Freeze H19 only after its one-shot controls, matched design, preflight, D07/D08 binding, exact source closure, and freeze continuity all pass. Run each cell once. A miss retains all evidence and requires a reviewed H20/H0 or new competing successor; no threshold lowering, unchanged rerun, hidden denominator change, or benchmark transition.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The plan explicitly targets reusable reasoning continuity, correctness-oriented outcomes, and cumulative model token efficiency.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: The plan explicitly retains GLM-5.3-flash qualification and the 8K-first small-window order.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench contract remains uncleared and development cannot claim clearance.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The explicit ontology chain starts from the reviewed round-nine counterevidence and leads to H19/H20/H0, a fixed experiment, observation, decision, and successor.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: All prior quality, token, recycling, exposure, and instrument failures remain listed constraints.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Native quality, exposure, integrity, correctness limits, and every model input/output token remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The exposed 8K cohort is separate from untouched confirmation, larger windows, SWE-bench, other models, and other domains.
criterion_verdicts.testability: H19 changes only presentation cadence and has fixed native, validity, token, per-generation, integrity, and stopping criteria.
